data.name: Blossom
data.gender_notes: Blossom is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Blossom is derived from the Greek word 'anemone', meaning 'refresher' or 'renewer'. It symbolizes new beginnings, rebirth, and renewal. In Christian tradition, it represents the resurrection of Jesus and the spiritual rebirth of believers. The name Blossom carries the meaning “New Beginning, Rebirth, Renewal” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blossom usually hope their child will grow to embody new beginning, rebirth, renewal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope, renewal, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Blossom belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “New Beginning, Rebirth, Renewal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Blossom total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
